algorithm-class-substitution.cost_hint: highest kernel yield: 20-30x reduction in kernel steps / rfl time
algorithm-class-substitution.match: exponential or unhoisted recursion with an equivalent closed-form or DP reduction
algorithm-class-substitution.provenance: SAIR Lean Kernel Challenge lanes (partition in-place DP S1/S1b, primecount sieve S6)
algorithm-class-substitution.rewrite: substitute algorithm class (e.g. in-place DP or structural sieve) and prove equivalence to spec

algorithm-class-substitution.cost_hint: 15-30x kernel instruction reduction on convolution/bitboard loops; preunfold% matches manual inlining (12.72M vs 18.49M for runtime combinators) at 4.2x smaller source
algorithm-class-substitution.match: inner loops over fixed-width integer/boolean arrays or linear recurrences with bounded slot bit-width, or manually unrolled block trees
algorithm-class-substitution.provenance: SAIR Lean Kernel Challenge (partition Kronecker SWAR convolution, ca-rule110 4-gate ANF + preunfold% t0..t6 block tree, fib unroll_top%, sha256 512-bit schedule window)
algorithm-class-substitution.rewrite: pack k lanes into a single b-bit GMP Nat word (Kronecker substitution / bitboard ANF) and use elaboration-time pre-unfolding (elab 'preunfold%' / 'unroll_top%') over binary-doubling combinators (t0..t6) to eliminate multi-thousand-line source inlining with 0 runtime unfold overhead

extraction.cost_hint: high-yield: counts once, serves N sites
extraction.match: a >=3-line proof block reused verbatim or modulo renaming
extraction.rewrite: name the block as a lemma; call it at each site

extraction.cost_hint: highest yield: reusable beyond the corpus
extraction.match: a generic block with no Mathlib equivalent (verified absent before naming)
extraction.rewrite: name it in the owning module; flag as an upstreaming candidate

extraction.match: three or more inline steps serving one standing theorem family
extraction.rewrite: package the steps as a named lemma trio in the theorem's module

extraction.match: a Cauchy/convergence argument assembled from pointwise and sum-level lemmas
extraction.rewrite: extract the four standard sub-steps as reusable convergence lemmas

kernel-friendly-term-design.cost_hint: high kernel yield: reduces defeq heartbeats and avoids WellFounded.fix traps
kernel-friendly-term-design.match: structural recursion or helper calls with heavy defeq unfolding overhead
kernel-friendly-term-design.provenance: SAIR Lean Kernel Challenge lanes (primecount L1 structural trial division S5)
kernel-friendly-term-design.rewrite: refactor to kernel-friendly primitives (structural Nat.rec, unrolled trial division, import-minimal path)

kernel-friendly-term-design.cost_hint: high kernel & trust yield: eliminates Classical.choice from decidable first-order theorems
kernel-friendly-term-design.match: Classical.choice leakage in first-order Nat/Int/Bool/BitVec theorems caused by split on &&/And or classical by_cases
kernel-friendly-term-design.provenance: lean_rules constructive-gate audit & AltProof bidirectional cross-pollination
kernel-friendly-term-design.rewrite: replace split/by_cases with Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, omega, or bv_decide to keep axiom closure Classical.choice-free

kernel-friendly-term-design.cost_hint: eval_nat% gives 0 runtime instruction overhead (vs +160K/invocation for closed def C) and eliminates multi-hundred-digit magic literals
kernel-friendly-term-design.match: giant decimal nat_lit constants (>64 bits) or repeated closed shift-add/mask expressions inside Nat.rec/List.rec step lambdas
kernel-friendly-term-design.provenance: SAIR Lean Kernel Challenge C++ type_checker.cpp whnf/m_whnf audit (partition DerivedConstants eval_nat% vs partCplusSpec, sha256 shaPaddingSuffix)
kernel-friendly-term-design.rewrite: evaluate closed constant expressions to raw nat_lit at elaboration time via an elab 'eval_nat%' macro (import Lean has 0 exported Lean.* refs), or hoist into a closed top-level def C : Nat := <formula> with a := rfl spec bridge (cached in m_st->m_whnf after 1 evaluation per kernel invocation)

redirect.cost_hint: reserved: no corpus fixture yet - the tool's first hit becomes it
redirect.match: by_contra-heavy proofs with a constructible direct witness
redirect.rewrite: restate as a direct construction (the JAR 2016 redirect class)

reflection.match: branched case analysis where one uniform simp set closes every branch
reflection.rewrite: replace the branches with one uniform simp call (the boolean-reflection pattern)
